subject: maths
topic: Trigonometry, angles of elevation/depression and bearings

kept.q: A ladder leans against a vertical wall so that its foot is 6 m away from the wall on level ground. If the ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground, find the length of the ladder to the nearest whole number.
kept.pidgin: Cos60° be 6/L, so L = 6 divide 0.5 wey be 12 m.

kept.q: A ship sails directly from port A to port B on a bearing of 070°. What is the bearing of port A from port B?
kept.explanation: The back bearing is found by adding 180° (since 070° is less than 180°): 070° + 180° = 250°.
kept.pidgin: Since 070° small pass 180°, add 180° to am: 070° + 180° = 250° be the bearing of A from B.

q.q: From a point on level ground 20 m away from the foot of a flagpole, the angle of elevation of the top of the pole is 30°. Find the height of the flagpole, correct to 1 decimal place.
q.explanation: tan30° = height/20, so height = 20 x tan30° = 20 x 0.5774 = 11.5 m.
q.pidgin: Tan30° be height/20, so height = 20 x tan30° wey give 11.5 m.

q.q: From the top of a tower 50 m high, the angle of depression of a parked car on level ground is 40°. Find the distance of the car from the foot of the tower, to the nearest whole number.
q.explanation: The angle of depression equals the angle of elevation from the car, so tan40° = 50/d, giving d = 50/tan40° = 50/0.8391 ≈ 60 m.
q.pidgin: Angle of depression equal angle of elevation from car side, so tan40° = 50/d. d = 50/tan40° wey be about 60 m.

q.q: Town P is 10 km from town Q on a bearing of N50°E. Town R is 15 km from Q on a bearing of S70°E. Find the distance PR, correct to 1 decimal place.
q.explanation: Bearing of P from Q is 050°, bearing of R from Q is 110°, so angle PQR = 110° - 50° = 60°. By cosine rule: PR^2 = 10^2 + 15^2 - 2(10)(15)cos60° = 175, so PR = sqrt(175) ≈ 13.2 km.
q.pidgin: Bearing of P na 050°, bearing of R na 110°, so angle PQR = 60°. Use cosine rule: PR^2 = 100+225-300cos60° = 175, PR = sqrt(175) wey be 13.2 km.

q.q: From a point on the ground, the angle of elevation of the top of a building is 32°. After walking 20 m directly towards the building, the angle of elevation becomes 50°. Find the height of the building, to the nearest whole number.
q.explanation: Let h be the height and d the distance from the second point: tan50° = h/d and tan32° = h/(d+20). Solving simultaneously gives h = 20tan32°/(1 - tan32°/tan50°) ≈ 26 m.
q.pidgin: Make h be height, d be distance from second point: tan50° = h/d, tan32° = h/(d+20). If you solve the two equations together, h go come be about 26 m.
